label: Mandaic bowl for Amkur and his son, Gorea 2003
summary: Sixteen-line Mandaic fever-protection bowl published by Maria Gorea in 2003 and later advertised as Drouot lot 47.

source.title: Mandaean magic cup of Amkur and his son — lot 47
source.citation: Gazette Drouot, ‘Mandaean Magic Cup of Amkur and His Son,’ lot 47, record 23199669, observed 4 September 2026; citing Maria Gorea, Semitica 51 (2003), 73–78 and illustration p. 90.
source.notes: Auction title, date, location, and auctioneer are subscriber-only; public object description is preserved.

texts.content: Prophylactic Mandaic incantation for Amkur and his son, with an exterior expression interpreted as referring to burning fever.

events.details: Public sale at Hôtel Drouot in the late 1990s; acquired for a private Parisian collection.
Published in ‘Trois nouvelles coupes magiques araméennes,’ Semitica 51, pp. 73–78, illustrated p. 90.
